excavation_context.character_description: Adult male grad student museum preparator, short dark hair, tanned skin, wearing a light blue tee shirt under a crisp white lab coat, blue jean slacks, and black dress shoes. Wears signature thin-rimmed black rectangular lens glasses.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_1 is inside an emergency field lab tent, striking a dense, heavy nodule of rusty red-brown ironstone with a mini rock pick. The hard, metallic mineral matrix cracks open cleanly to reveal a thick, spike-covered armor tail plate from a Polacanthus dinosaur. Bright utility lamps creating sharp highlights on the metallic rock edges and his black rectangular glasses. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
